title: Vegan Date Cake
description: A moist and delicious vegan date cake made with medjool dates and fluffy texture.
instructions: Grease a 20cm (8-inch) round cake pan with coconut oil.
Sift together cake mix, baking powder, and salt.
In a blender or food processor, blend dates, date syrup, and coconut oil until smooth.
Add vanilla extract and mix well.
Pour the blended mixture into the sifted dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared cake pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
If using walnuts, sprinkle on top of the cake once cooled.
